thread:
Incident Bot: P0 - automated pager: routing policy mismatch causing cascading fallbacks in eu-west (INC-2026-045). Paging oncall. @Andrea (oncall) you’re up :rotating_light:
Andrea (oncall): on it, joining now. any customer reports so far?
Denise (support): getting 5 support tickets in last 6m, theme: "sudden failures in tool calls" and "we get short responses / truncated output". customers: 3 enterprise customers with heavy tool-calling.
Matt (eng-runtime): seeing a surge of fallback routing from eu-west to eu-central-quant variants. logs show repeated model swap attempts -> rejection -> fallback -> retry loop.
Raj (ml-ops): that sounds like the compatibility matrix flagged eu-central-quant as compatible for tool calls but it actually lacks tool-calling stubs (our build omitted TOOLCALL flag in the quantized pipeline).
Sophia (sre): metrics: 5xx spikes on routing-service and 429s on runtime-proxy. Latency SLO breached for eu-west 2x baseline.
Andrea (oncall): quick customer impact: are requests failing (errors) or returning degraded outputs?
Denise (support): mix: ~60% tool-call requests return error strings, ~30% return short/no tool invocation token, 10% succeed. Customers complaining about downstream app errors.
Matt (eng-runtime): stack traces show RuntimeError: tool_call_not_supported at runtime when plugin negotiation happens. That's the quant variant behavior.
Raj (ml-ops): I can confirm the model availability table lists QUANT_XY as supporting tool_call:true and context_len:4096 in the compatibility service (compat-service). That was an automated import from onboarding pipeline yesterday — seems wrong.
Andrea (oncall): assign mitigations. Immediate idea: disable smart-routing policy that prefers region fallback to quant variants for tool_call routes. Roll back to last known-good routing policy.
Ops Lead: Agreed — set policy override to static primary-only for routes with tool_call header until we patch compat-service. Do it ASAP.
Eng-Platform: I can flip a policy flag. Command:
```
# set policy to primary-only for tool_call routes
curl -X POST "https://platform-admin/redwood/v1/policies/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"match":{"headers":"x-redwood-toolcall"},"policy":{"mode":"primary_only","reason":"compat-issue-INC-2026-045"}}'
```
Sophia (sre): while that runs, add a temporary circuit breaker on fallback retries to stop the loop: set fallback_max_retries=0 for eu-west to force fast failure instead of oscillation.
Deploy Bot: policy override applied by Eng-Platform at 2475123490.
Matt (eng-runtime): applying circuit breaker via runtime-config. patch:
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{"region":"eu-west","fallback_max_retries":0}
```
Andrea (oncall): confirm we also need to pin existing sessions to their primary model to avoid mid-flight swaps. Is that supported?
Matt (eng-runtime): yes, using sticky-model header. I'll inject sticky header for active connections for the next 30m.
Raj (ml-ops): I'm rolling back the compat-service change that incorrectly marked QUANT_XY as toolcall=true. Running rollback now (reverting import job).
Raj (ml-ops): rollback complete at 2475123570. New compatibility matrix shows QUANT_XY: tool_call:false, context_len:2048.
Denise (support): tickets updated: "we're seeing reduced failures" from 3 customers. Keep me posted so I can notify account owners.
Sophia (sre): metrics trending down. 5xx down 70% in the last 4m. latency improving.
Andrea (oncall): good. next steps: patch onboarding importer to validate tool_call flag for quant artifacts, add unit tests. Raj, can you own that?
Raj (ml-ops): yes, I'll add a validation step: check model artifact metadata for TOOLCALL support and a quick binary probe if needed. ETA for hotfix? 4 hours.
Ops Lead: we need a postmortem and an RCA. Also recommend a short-term monitoring rule: emit alert if compat-service claims tool_call:true for any model variant with quantization_level>0.
Eng-Platform: adding that alert now. rule: compat-service:compat_mismatch -> fire when tool_call=true AND quantization_level>0.
Andrea (oncall): customer impact summary for incident notes: affected routes: /v1/chat and /v1/function_calling for eu-west; approx 12k requests failed over 20m window; 3 enterprise customers saw degraded UX. No data leak, only availability/functional regressions.
Denise (support): I'll send templated customer status: initial cause identified and mitigations applied, root cause: compatibility matrix import bug; ETA for full fix: 4h; follow-up with postmortem within 48h.
Matt (eng-runtime): we also need to ensure quant variants advertise correct context length. The mismatch (matrix said 4096, real is 2048) caused clients to truncate contexts before tool negotiation, contributing to failures. I'll add a runtime self-reporting heartbeat that corrects compat-service if mismatch detected.
Raj (ml-ops): I'll coordinate on that heartbeat. Also scheduling a canary re-import into staging with stricter checks.
Andrea (oncall): status? are we safe to close the page? Is there residual risk of oscillation?
Sophia (sre): risk reduced. fallback retries set to 0, policy override in place, compat rollback done. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and then remove sticky-model header gracefully.
Andrea (oncall): thanks team. I'll mark incident as mitigated in the incident tracker. Incident Bot: please create INC-2026-045 and attach logs.
Incident Bot: INC-2026-045 created/updated, timeline recorded.
Denise (support): emailing affected customers now with interim summary.
Ops Lead: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) fix importer validation (Raj) 2) alert rule (Eng-Platform) 3) runtime self-reporting (Matt) 4) update rollout checklist for model variants (all). Owners assigned.
Andrea (oncall): closing thread for active paging, monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
